title: Demo: Implicit Context
summary: Jonathan Blow gives a formal, hour-long demo of his Jai compiler focused on the implicit context feature. The context carries things like allocators through a program without explicit parameter passing, and the talk walks through the code.
why: Cited in discussions of memory arenas and allocators as the origin of the implicit context idea that later appeared in Odin and other languages.

quote.text: Here's that Jonathan Blow stream if anyone else is curious
